# pve_hardware_mapping_usb (Data Source)

Reads a single logical USB hardware mapping (`GET /cluster/mapping/usb/{id}`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_hardware_mapping_usb" "ups" {
  id = "ups"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the logical USB mapping to read.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the logical USB device.
- `map` (Attributes List) Per-node device entries of the mapping. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--map))

<a id="nestedatt--map"></a>
### Nested Schema for `map`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the node-specific device.
- `id` (String) Expected vendor and device ID in `vendor:device` form.
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `path` (String) USB port path of the device.
